concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @Controller as :Controller
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.stereotype.Controller' SET c:Controller RETURN count(c) AS MarkedControllers

concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @RestController as :RestController and :Controller
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController' SET c:RestController, c:Controller RETURN count(c) AS MarkedRestControllers

concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @Service as :Service
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.stereotype.Service' SET c:Service RETURN count(c) AS MarkedServices

concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @Repository as :Repository
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.stereotype.Repository' SET c:Repository RETURN count(c) AS MarkedRepositories

concept.description: Labels every class annotated with JPA/Hibernate entity markers as :DbEntity
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn IN [ 'javax.persistence.Entity', 'jakarta.persistence.Entity', 'javax.persistence.Table', 'jakarta.persistence.Table' ] SET c:DbEntity RETURN count(c) AS MarkedDbEntities

concept.description: Labels classes located inside domain packages without framework annotations as :DomainObject
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.domain' AND NOT c:Controller AND NOT c:Service AND NOT c:Repository AND NOT c:DbEntity SET c:DomainObject RETURN count(c) AS MarkedDomainObjects

concept.description: Identifies and labels packages participating in a standard Layered Architecture
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.controller' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.service' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.repository' SET p:LayeredArchitecturePackage RETURN count(p) AS MarkedLayeredPackages

concept.description: Identifies and labels packages participating in a Hexagonal Architecture
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.domain' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.infrastructure' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.adapter' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.port' SET p:HexagonalArchitecturePackage RETURN count(p) AS MarkedHexagonalPackages

concept.description: Labels classes inside the core domain package structure as :DomainLayer
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn ENDS WITH '.domain' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.domain.' SET c:DomainLayer RETURN count(c) AS MarkedDomainLayerClasses

concept.description: Labels classes interacting with or exposing external systems/clients
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.client' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.external' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.integration' SET c:ExternalApiCallLayer RETURN count(c) AS MarkedExternalApiClasses

concept.description: Labels classes located in adapter packages as :Adapter
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.adapter' SET c:Adapter RETURN count(c) AS MarkedAdapters

concept.description: Labels inbound interfaces/use-cases as :PortIn
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(i:Interface) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.port.in' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.ports.in' OR i.name ENDS WITH 'UseCase' SET i:PortIn RETURN count(i) AS MarkedPortsIn

concept.description: Labels outbound interfaces/SPIs as :PortOut
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(i:Interface) WHERE p.fqn CONTAINS '.port.out' OR p.fqn CONTAINS '.ports.out' OR i.name ENDS WITH 'Port' SET i:PortOut RETURN count(i) AS MarkedPortsOut

concept.description: Labels driving/primary infrastructure configurations and entry points
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c:Controller OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.adapter.in' OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.infrastructure.web' SET c:InfrastructurePrimary RETURN count(c) AS MarkedPrimaryInfra

concept.description: Labels driven/secondary infrastructure components (persistence, messaging clients)
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c:Repository OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.adapter.out' OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.infrastructure.persistence' SET c:InfrastructureSecondary RETURN count(c) AS MarkedSecondaryInfra

concept.description: Labels core domain services acting explicitly as application Use Cases
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Service)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(i:PortIn) SET c:UseCaseService RETURN count(c) AS MarkedUseCaseServices

concept.description: Labels elements protected by a Retry mechanism
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn CONTAINS 'io.github.resilience4j.retry.annotation.Retry' SET e:ResilienceRetry RETURN count(e) AS MarkedRetryElements

concept.description: Labels elements protected by a Circuit Breaker
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn CONTAINS 'io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker' SET e:ResilienceCircuitBreaker RETURN count(e) AS MarkedCircuitBreakers

concept.description: Labels elements throttled by a Rate Limiter
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn CONTAINS 'io.github.resilience4j.ratelimiter.annotation.RateLimiter' SET e:ResilienceRateLimiter RETURN count(e) AS MarkedRateLimiters

concept.description: Labels elements isolated via Bulkhead pattern
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn CONTAINS 'io.github.resilience4j.bulkhead.annotation.Bulkhead' SET e:ResilienceBulkhead RETURN count(e) AS MarkedBulkheads

concept.description: Labels elements governed by a Time Limiter / Timeout configuration
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn CONTAINS 'io.github.resilience4j.timelimiter.annotation.TimeLimiter' SET e:ResilienceTimeout RETURN count(e) AS MarkedTimeouts

concept.description: Identifies methods serving explicitly as fallback execution paths
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name STARTS WITH 'fallback' OR m.name CONTAINS 'Fallback' SET m:ResilienceFallback RETURN count(m) AS MarkedFallbacks

concept.description: Labels methods or classes configured with caching capabilities
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn IN [ 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachePut', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict' ] SET e:CachedElement RETURN count(e) AS MarkedCachedElements

concept.description: Labels methods executing asynchronously or interacting with concurrency managers
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async' SET e:AsynchronousExecution RETURN count(e) AS MarkedMultithreadedElements

concept.description: Labels components identified as structural units inside a business workflow execution
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.fqn CONTAINS '.workflow.' OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.process.' OR c.name ENDS WITH 'Delegate' SET c:WorkflowComponent RETURN count(c) AS MarkedWorkflowComponents

concept.description: Labels Java components interacting with BPMN systems (e.g., Camunda Java Delegates)
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.camunda.bpm.engine.delegate.JavaDelegate' SET c:BpmnTaskDelegate RETURN count(c) AS MarkedBpmnDelegates

concept.description: Enriches class and interface nodes participating in deep hierarchies
concept.cypher: MATCH (sub:Type)-[:EXTENDS|IMPLEMENTS]->(sup:Type) SET sub:HasSuperType, sup:HasSubType RETURN count(sub) AS ProcessedInheritanceNodes

concept.description: Marks strong composition fields (private lifecycle-bound custom internal types)
concept.cypher: MATCH (c1:Class)-[:DECLARES]->(f:Field)-[:OF_TYPE]->(c2:Class) WHERE NOT f.type STARTS WITH 'java.' AND NOT f.type STARTS WITH 'org.springframework.' SET f:CompositionField RETURN count(f) AS MarkedCompositions

concept.description: Marks aggregation fields representing structural collection-based listings
concept.cypher: MATCH (c1:Class)-[:DECLARES]->(f:Field) WHERE f.signature CONTAINS 'java.util.List' OR f.signature CONTAINS 'java.util.Set' OR f.signature CONTAINS 'java.util.Collection' SET f:AggregationField RETURN count(f) AS MarkedAggregations

concept.description: Identifies and labels simple behavioral associations/uses structural connections
concept.cypher: MATCH (c1:Class)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(c2:Class) WHERE NOT (c1)-[:DECLARES]->(:Field)-[:OF_TYPE]->(c2) SET c1:AssociatedElement RETURN count(c1) AS MarkedAssociations

concept.description: Tags methods vulnerable to transitive propagation whenever a sibling signature or call contract changes
concept.cypher: MATCH (m2:Method)<-[:INVOKES]-(m1:Method) SET m2:ImpactTraceable, m1:ImpactTraceable RETURN count(m2) AS TraceableMethods

concept.description: Tags structural inheritance endpoints vulnerable to changes up or down the graph tree
concept.cypher: MATCH path=(sub:Type)-[:EXTENDS|IMPLEMENTS*]->(sup:Type) FOREACH (n IN nodes(path) | SET n:HierarchyImpactTraceable) RETURN count(sub) AS TraceableHierarchies

concept.description: Maps and labels internal access operations linked tightly to attribute type structures
concept.cypher: MATCH (m:Method)-[r:READS|WRITES]->(f:Field) SET f:FieldImpactTraceable, m:AccessorImpactTraceable RETURN count(f) AS TraceableFields

concept.description: Tags elements whose run/compile behaviors depend strictly on structural annotations
concept.cypher: MATCH (e)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation) SET e:AnnotationImpactTraceable RETURN count(e) AS TraceableAnnotatedElements

concept.description: Tags upstream layers and client spaces susceptible to package refactoring and structural shifts
concept.cypher: MATCH (p1:Package)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(p2:Package) SET p1:PackageImpactTraceable, p2:PackageImpactTraceable RETURN count(p1) AS TraceablePackages

concept.description: Identifies classic GoF Singletons structural signatures (Private constructor + Static self reference field)
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:DECLARES]->(f:Field)-[:OF_TYPE]->(c) MATCH (c)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name = '<init>' AND m.visibility = 'private' SET c:SingletonPattern RETURN count(c) AS MarkedSingletons

concept.description: Identifies Factory patterns via naming conventions or dedicated instantiation types
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.name ENDS WITH 'Factory' OR c.name ENDS WITH 'Creator' SET c:FactoryPattern RETURN count(c) AS MarkedFactories

concept.description: Identifies Strategy pattern structures (Context class referencing an interface implemented by multiple variants)
concept.cypher: MATCH (strategy:Interface)<-[:IMPLEMENTS]-(impl:Class) MATCH (context:Class)-[:DECLARES]->(f:Field)-[:OF_TYPE]->(strategy) SET strategy:StrategyPatternInterface, impl:StrategyPatternImplementation, context:StrategyPatternContext RETURN count(strategy) AS MarkedStrategyInterfaces

concept.description: Identifies Saga Orchestrators or Participants in distributed transactions via framework markers or packaging
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Saga' OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.saga' OR EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn CONTAINS 'Saga' } SET c:SagaPattern RETURN count(c) AS MarkedSagas

concept.description: Identifies Transactional Outbox components or event publishers dedicated to database reliability relay
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Outbox' OR c.fqn CONTAINS '.outbox' SET c:OutboxPattern RETURN count(c) AS MarkedOutboxElements

concept.description: Links every Java :Class node to its corresponding physical .java :File node (absolute path) by matching FQN with the file path, handling cross-platform separators and inner classes.
Links Test classes to their corresponding production Classes based on naming convention.
concept.cypher: MATCH (test:Class) WHERE test.name ENDS WITH 'Test' OR test.name ENDS WITH 'IT' WITH test, substring(test.name, 0, size(test.name) - 4) AS prodClassNameShort, substring(test.name, 0, size(test.name) - 2) AS prodClassNameIT MATCH (prod:Class) WHERE prod.name = prodClassNameShort OR prod.name = prodClassNameIT MERGE (test)-[:TESTS]->(prod) RETURN count(test) AS LinkedTests

concept.description: Links Spring @Value annotations to the physical configuration properties used.
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:DECLARES]->(f:Field)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value' // Extraction de la clé brute ex: ${my.config.key} -> my.config.key WITH f, a.value AS rawValue WHERE rawValue STARTS WITH '${' WITH f, substring(rawValue, 2, size(rawValue) - 3) AS propertyKey SET f.usesProperty = propertyKey RETURN count(f) AS LinkedProperties

concept.description: Identifies classes that are completely unreachable from the Spring Boot main application entry point.
Links methods throwing custom exceptions to their respective Spring @ExceptionHandler.
concept.cypher: MATCH (m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(:Method {name: '<init>'})<-[:DECLARES]-(ex:Class)-[:EXTENDS*]->(:Type {fqn: 'java.lang.Exception'}) MATCH (handler:Method)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler' // Idéalement on matcherait la valeur de l'annotation, ici on simplifie par correspondance de type SET m:ThrowsException, handler:ExceptionInterceptor MERGE (m)-[:PROPAGATES_ERROR_TO]->(ex) RETURN count(m) AS LinkedExceptionPaths
